nTrust Core Platform

nTrust Core is the engine that powers TrustGuard, PrivacyGuard, TrustAudit and the services in the nTrust portfolio — one automation foundation with consistent policy, logging, and security controls.

ISO 27001·SOC 2·NIST AI RMF·EU AI Act·Zero-Trust Architecture
Overview

A closer look

Every nTrust product runs on a common automation core. nTrust Core provides the policy engine, audit ledger, gateway, and orchestration layers that keep behavior consistent, auditable, and secure across the portfolio.

For customers, that means one control plane, one audit trail, and one consistent model for how policy is authored and enforced — no matter which nTrust solutions you adopt.

Capabilities

What you get

📜

Policy Engine

A single, versioned policy model drives controls across all connected nTrust solutions.

💾

Immutable Audit Ledger

Every state change is written to a cryptographic, tamper-evident ledger.

🔒

Zero-Trust Gateway

Default-deny access control, encryption enforcement and continuous verification.

🔄

Orchestration Runtime

Automated workflows coordinate scanning, validation and remediation tasks.

🚀

Tenant Provisioning

Repeatable, isolated provisioning for teams, business units and customers.

📡

API-First Design

Every capability is exposed through documented, versioned APIs.

Who it’s for

  • Enterprises standardizing security automation across business units.
  • Teams building internal compliance tooling on a proven foundation.
  • Organizations consolidating point tools onto one auditable platform.

Compliance alignment

Every nTrust solution is engineered with enterprise-grade security from day one and maps to the frameworks your organization operates under:

  • NIST AI RMF (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage)
  • EU AI Act transparency & logging obligations
  • ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control alignment
  • GDPR and CCPA privacy requirements
